_comment: The settlement rules, written once and asserted from both sides. core/wagers.py grades account picks in the nightly job; picks.ts grades local ones in the browser. A user must never see one answer on their picks page and a different one on the leaderboard, so both test suites read this file: tests/test_wagers.py and src/lib/picks.test.ts. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

cases.name: over exactly on a whole line counts as a hit
under exactly on a whole line loses
a longshot pays the plus price
no stat line voids rather than losing
a zero stat line is a real result, not a void
